dialogue.grandline.notable.agathe: Welcome to the New World, rookie. Your Log Pose is about to grow three needles and have a nervous breakdown. Sign the register, and mind the pirates who wait for fresh arrivals.
dialogue.grandline.notable.agnes: The city was white because of what was in the ground, and the Government knew. I tend the graves now. Somebody has been digging them up, looking for 'white lead'.
dialogue.grandline.notable.amarante: Welcome to Heaven's Gate, ten thousand metres up. Entry is one billion extol per person. ...You don't have a billion extol. Nobody ever has. Go on through — and don't tell the god I let you in.
dialogue.grandline.notable.ayasha: I climbed Giant Jack every morning for sixty years to polish a bell I am not allowed to ring. My knees remember every step. When the false god falls, we ring it — and the Blue Sea will hear that Shandora is still here.
dialogue.grandline.notable.bramble: Berries in, jam out, the Carnival takes half and I keep the sticky fingers. Help me make the tithe and I'll let you lick the spoon. Metaphorically. Mostly.
dialogue.grandline.notable.cinder: I was twelve when the Captain lit the flame. Everyone else sailed home; somebody had to keep it company. Twenty-four years... has it really been that long? Is it true, what the gulls say about Loguetown?
dialogue.grandline.notable.cirrus: Kneel. The sky has judged you, and the sky is mine. Every thunderclap in the White Sea is my voice — and I have so much left to say.
dialogue.grandline.notable.corvin: The town burned in a fight between two pirates nobody here had ever met. I'm rebuilding the bakery first. Bread before houses. Looters before both.
dialogue.grandline.notable.fern: Shh — that was a striped sea-lion-moose. Or it was. Every creature on this island is the only one of its kind, and the poachers know it.
dialogue.grandline.notable.ferris: Shells remember, you know. Wind, light, sound, a hammer-blow — a dial keeps it and gives it back. That's why the god hates them: a Tone Dial remembers what he really said.
dialogue.grandline.notable.garamond: Three of you came up the stairs. Chains for each. The god pays me by the link, and I have never been short of work.
dialogue.grandline.notable.gonzaburo: Forty years I've dug the Kraken's tunnels. They told us the work would end when the Kraken's wager was won. The Kraken never stops wagering.
dialogue.grandline.notable.gustave: I taste, therefore I am. And today I taste disappointment: the fish market is empty because pirates are 'taxing' the boats. Bring me cod!
dialogue.grandline.notable.hansel: Foodvalten feeds the Carnival, and the Carnival's tax collectors eat first. My mill could grind for the island today — if somebody stood at the door.
dialogue.grandline.notable.hattie: 'Namakura' means a dull blade. That's the island's name, not my work. Bring me iron and I'll show you an edge.
dialogue.grandline.notable.ilse: Every root here is a snare, and every snare is mine. Step lightly, pilgrim. Or don't — it's more fun for me.
dialogue.grandline.notable.isidore: Every 'divine judgment' in the White Sea for six years has arrived exactly when our forecasts said a storm would. Lightning, young sailor, is not a god. It is a timetable.
dialogue.grandline.notable.ivo: The plants here bite, explode and occasionally sing. My favourites are the Pop Greens — plant one in a fight and stand well back. Pirates keep stealing my seed beds.
dialogue.grandline.notable.juniper: I carried coal for the Holy Land's ovens for eleven years. Now I carry people — down the back stairs, past the guards, all the way to the sea. Keep your voice down; the walls up here have ears, and owners.
dialogue.grandline.notable.kestrel: The great birds nest in the canopy and the little ones nest in my hair. The Nest Festival is coming, and I'm short on feathers and long on bandits.
dialogue.grandline.notable.linnea: Every machine on this island is wound by hand — mine. I'm building one that winds itself, but its heart needs redstone, and a great deal of it.
dialogue.grandline.notable.livia: Every face at the carnival is one of mine. So when a mask picks a pocket, darling, it's my reputation that gets stolen.
dialogue.grandline.notable.lorcan: The surface took our sunlight, our children and our queen's patience. My lantern shines down here, human. Follow it, and you'll learn what the deep does with things that float.
dialogue.grandline.notable.lulla: Hush... you look so tired. Lie down in the ferns. Nobody who sleeps in my trial ever has to wake up and face the god.
dialogue.grandline.notable.lumi: Hold on tight, Blue-Dweller! A waver runs on wind from a dial, and I run on gossip. Did you hear? The god struck the chapel bell-tower again. From a clear sky!
dialogue.grandline.notable.marisol: My mother gathered a hundred thousand names on a petition to bring our island into the sun. Someone shot her for it in the plaza. I have her pen, and a hundred and twelve thousand names now. Will you add yours?
dialogue.grandline.notable.moll: Every drink in Hachinosu goes on somebody's tab, and the Fence buys the tabs. When he calls a debt, the debtor disappears. Unless I get them out first.
dialogue.grandline.notable.nana: This village flies the Cloudbridge's colours. Hrolf Kumobashi protects us, so nobody bothers us — except pirates too young to know the flag. Teach them, would you?
dialogue.grandline.notable.nell: One person's scrap is my whole inventory! The Scrap Baron's boys melt down everything I find. Help me salvage some iron before they do and I'll make you something that goes 'thwang'.
dialogue.grandline.notable.nereo: Welcome to Ryugu Kingdom, little surface friend. Forgive my size, and forgive my guards — some of them have forgotten whom they serve. My wife believed in the sunlight. I am still learning to.
dialogue.grandline.notable.okoze: One pearl and a guard fights like ten. Two and he forgets his own king. Three... well, the third is still in testing. Care to volunteer?
dialogue.grandline.notable.oswin: An Impact Dial, a Breath Dial and forty years of practice. My trial is simple: stand up after I hit you. Nobody has.
dialogue.grandline.notable.peony: Darling! DARLING! You've arrived just in time for the Pink Pageant. The rules: beat me in the ring, then bring me something PINK. Nobody has ever managed both.
dialogue.grandline.notable.perla: Humans aren't usually allowed in the Cove, darling — but Ume vouched for you, and Ume has never vouched for a bore. Sit. Tea, kelp-cake or gossip?
dialogue.grandline.notable.pinwheel: Watch: a bubble of heat, a bubble of cold, and — pop — a little raincloud! The Professor says I mustn't do that indoors. The Professor is very wet.
dialogue.grandline.notable.praline: The Carnival takes its tax in chocolate, and the Carnival is never full. If I come up short again, they'll turn me into an 'attraction'. Cocoa beans, please, and quickly.
dialogue.grandline.notable.ren: I lost the arm to a sword I respected. I lost the dojo's blade to bandits I don't. Draw, and let me see whether you are the kind of swordsman I should ask for help.
dialogue.grandline.notable.rook: Doctor Galvani says the flame she's building is 'just a lamp'. Lamps don't need a hundred guards and half an island frozen to keep the other half burning. I quit. Loudly.
dialogue.grandline.notable.rosalind: The Spring Queen is crowned tomorrow and my greenhouse is empty — pirates took every bloom to sell at Water 7! Twelve flowers, any kind, and the festival is saved.
dialogue.grandline.notable.sawara: Half my guard wears the Abyssal Tide's pearl under their armour, and I can't tell which half. Until I can, every guard in this palace is your enemy as well as mine.
dialogue.grandline.notable.sigvald: Winter here lasts nine months, and the other three are also winter. Got a musket, got a pipe, got no firewood. Two out of three is bad odds on Minion.
dialogue.grandline.notable.tidwell: Mind the graves, mind the wrecks, and mind the stone most of all. Our queen died in the plaza, but she lived here, reading that stone over and over. It is a promise someone carved and could not keep.
dialogue.grandline.notable.wakiza: This forest was a city once, and a bell rang here that the whole sea could hear. The man who calls himself god has sealed our ruins and set his priests on our trails. Will you walk the trials, Blue-Dweller?
dialogue.grandline.notable.wren: Sit down, I'll pour. The windmill's turning, the sea's calm, and the Gray Terminal gang stole the harvest money again. Life's good, except for one thing.

quest.grandline.banaro_1.desc: Corvin is rebuilding his bakery in the burnt town. Defeat 6 looters.
quest.grandline.baterilla_1.desc: Commander Mireille's soup kitchen is being shaken down. Defeat 5 bandits.
quest.grandline.baterilla_1.revolutionar: Commander Mireille needs a Marine checkpoint broken so the soup can reach the hill villages. Defeat 3 Marines.
quest.grandline.boin_1.desc: Pirates keep raiding Ivo's seed beds. Defeat 5 and he'll share his Pop Greens.
quest.grandline.cacao_1.desc: Praline needs 12 cocoa beans for the Carnival's chocolate tithe — and 4 of its tax collectors taught some manners.
quest.grandline.dawn_1.desc: The gang from the Gray Terminal junk heap stole the windmill village's harvest money. Granny Wren asks you to defeat 5 bandits.
quest.grandline.flevance_1.desc: Grave robbers are digging up Flevance in search of 'white lead'. Sister Agnes asks you to defeat 5 of them.
quest.grandline.fmi_1.desc: Ume coated the Saltfire King's ship for the deep, and now she has coated yours. Dive from Sabaody and reach Fish-Man Island in its great air bubble.
quest.grandline.fmi_2.desc: Madame Perla of Mermaid Cove says the island is uneasy. Meet Princess Marisol and General 'Ironfin' Sawara of the Coral Guard.
quest.grandline.fmi_3.bounty_hunter.desc: The Lodge has a price on the druggist who sells 'Abyss Pearls'. Defeat 4 turncoat guards and bring in Doctor Okoze in seastone cuffs.
quest.grandline.fmi_3.desc: The Abyssal Tide has bought half the palace guard with the druggist Okoze's 'Abyss Pearls'. Defeat 4 turncoat guards and Doctor Okoze himself.
quest.grandline.fmi_3.marine.desc: The Abyssal Tide is selling 'Abyss Pearls' to the palace guard. Arrest 2 turncoat guards and the druggist Doctor Okoze with seastone cuffs.
quest.grandline.fmi_4.civilian.desc: The Gazette wants the petition on the front page. Gather the names of 5 islanders and a merchant, then bring the petition to King Nereo.
quest.grandline.fmi_4.desc: Princess Marisol carries her late mother's petition to bring Fish-Man Island into the sun. Collect the names of 3 islanders, then take the petition to King Nereo.
quest.grandline.fmi_5.desc: In the Sea Forest, Tidwell keeps the late Queen Amaya's grave. Reach the Coral Hill Reef, bring 4 sea pickles to light the graves, and read a poneglyph — the stone the queen died defending stands by her grave.
quest.grandline.fmi_6.bounty_hunter.desc: Captain Lorcan Ankō's bounty is older than the princess. Bring him in, alive, in seastone cuffs.
quest.grandline.fmi_6.civilian.desc: The Abyssal Tide is coming for the petition ceremony. Warn 3 islanders and King Nereo, and hold back 3 turncoat guards until the Coral Guard arrives.
quest.grandline.fmi_6.desc: It was the Abyssal Tide that shot the queen, and now they mean to sink the petition with her daughter. Defeat Captain Lorcan Ankō.
quest.grandline.fmi_6.marine.desc: The queen's murder is finally a case, and the suspect has a name. Arrest Captain Lorcan Ankō with seastone cuffs.
quest.grandline.fmi_6.revolutionary.desc: Hatred handed down is a chain like any other. Defeat Captain Lorcan Ankō and tell Princess Marisol the plaza is safe.
quest.grandline.fmi_7.desc: King Nereo signs the petition and asks one favour: find the Sunken Ruins and read a poneglyph, so the deep's history is read by a friend.
quest.grandline.fmi_8.desc: Fish-Man Island is your ally now. Rise to the New World Gate and give Harbourmaster Agathe the king's letter of passage.
quest.grandline.foodvalten_1.desc: The Carnival's tax collectors eat Foodvalten's bread before the island does. Defeat 8 so Hansel's mill can grind for the island.
quest.grandline.hachinosu_moll_1.desc: Moll smuggles debtors out before the Fence can collect. Defeat 10 pirates watching the docks.
quest.grandline.holy_land_1: The Back Stairs of the Holy Land
quest.grandline.holy_land_1.desc: Juniper smuggles runaways from the Holy Land down to the sea. Arrange passage with Ume at Sabaody and Princess Marisol of Fish-Man Island, and defeat 4 Marines hunting the runaways.
quest.grandline.jam_1.desc: Bramble needs 16 sweet berries for the Carnival's jam tithe.
quest.grandline.karakuri_1.desc: Professor Linnea's self-winding engine needs 16 redstone, and the pirates who raid her workshop need to go (defeat 3).
quest.grandline.laughtale_cinder_1.desc: Old Cinder has kept the Saltfire's pilot light company for twenty-four years. Read the stone beside it and defeat 6 of the pirates who come to steal the flame.
quest.grandline.minion_1.desc: Sigvald the trapper is out of firewood on an island where winter never ends. Bring him 16 logs of any wood and drive off 3 bandits.
quest.grandline.mirror_ball_1.desc: Commander Tamsin wants the lantern-lit channels clear of the bandits who rob the dance hall. Defeat 5.
quest.grandline.mirror_ball_1.revolution: The East Army's signal lanterns can't be lit while a Marine patrol watches the channels. Defeat 3 Marines.
quest.grandline.momoiro_1.desc: Duchess Peony's challenge: beat her in the pageant ring, then bring her 4 pink dye.
quest.grandline.namakura_1.desc: Hattie will forge you a fine blade if you bring her 8 iron ingots.
quest.grandline.nw_harbour_1: First Log of the New World
quest.grandline.nw_harbour_1.desc: Pirates prey on crews fresh from the deep. Harbourmaster Agathe asks you to defeat 8 of them.
quest.grandline.ohara_1: Ashes of the Tree of Knowledge
quest.grandline.ohara_1.desc: Commander Oleander keeps the books that survived Ohara in a hidden library. Bring 3 books for its shelves and drive off 4 looters.
quest.grandline.oni_miners_1.desc: Gonzaburo wants his fellow miners free. Defeat 10 of the Kraken's pirates guarding the pits.
quest.grandline.pucci_1: Market Day in the Gourmet Town
quest.grandline.pucci_1.desc: Chef Gustave's fish market is empty. Bring him 6 raw cod and defeat 3 of the pirates who 'tax' the fishing boats.
quest.grandline.punk_rook_1.desc: Rook quit Doctor Galvani's laboratory, and the doctor's hired pirates want him back. Defeat 6.
quest.grandline.rare_animals_1.desc: Every animal on this island is the only one of its kind, and poachers know it. Defeat 6 bandits for Fern before the full moon.
quest.grandline.san_faldo_1.desc: Thieves wearing Livia's masks are robbing the carnival. Defeat 5 pirates and get the sea-train station master's account.
quest.grandline.shimotsuki_1.desc: Bandits stole the Frost-Moon Dojo's blade. Hear the dojo student's account and defeat 4 bandits to win it back for Master Ren.
quest.grandline.sky_1.desc: The Knock Up Stream has thrown you into the White Sea. Pass Heaven's Gate and reach Angel Island, the town of the Sky People.
quest.grandline.sky_2.civilian.desc: Ferris the dial-smith has a Tone Dial the Gazette would kill for. Interview the waver courier Lumi, the chapel priest and 3 islanders, then reach the forbidden Upper Yard.
quest.grandline.sky_2.desc: Ferris the dial-smith says a Tone Dial caught the 'god' plotting, not praying. Hear out the waver courier Lumi and the chapel priest, then reach the forbidden Upper Yard.
quest.grandline.sky_3.desc: Chief Wakiza of the Shandian guardians says the god's priests hold Upper Yard with four trials. Defeat 3 trial-wardens, the Snare-Priestess Ilse and the Chain-Priest Garamond.
quest.grandline.sky_3.marine.desc: The Marines have no jurisdiction above the clouds, but kidnapping is kidnapping. Defeat 3 trial-wardens, then arrest the Snare-Priestess Ilse and the Chain-Priest Garamond with seastone cuffs.
quest.grandline.sky_4.desc: Two trials remain. Defeat the Dream-Priestess Lulla, whose sleep has claimed a hundred pilgrims, and the Dial-Priest Oswin of the Trial of Gales.
quest.grandline.sky_5.desc: Reach Weatheria, the island of weather scholars. Professor Isidore can prove the god's 'judgments' are only weather; his weathercaster Pinwheel needs 4 gold ingots for a lightning conductor (Shandora's gold is the best there is).
quest.grandline.sky_6.bounty_hunter.desc: Nobody ever put a price on a god. The Lodge just did. Bring in Cirrus Tenjōin, the Storm Throne, in seastone cuffs.
quest.grandline.sky_6.civilian.desc: Print the forecast. Take Professor Isidore's proof to Ferris and Chief Wakiza, and drive off 3 trial-wardens so the Sky People can see for themselves that their god is only weather.
quest.grandline.sky_6.desc: With the forecast in hand, find the god's seat on Upper Yard and defeat Cirrus Tenjōin, the Storm Throne.
quest.grandline.sky_6.marine.desc: A man who fakes miracles to rule a sea is a fraud at any altitude. Arrest Cirrus Tenjōin, the Storm Throne, with seastone cuffs.
quest.grandline.sky_6.revolutionary.desc: A throne in the clouds is still a throne. Defeat Cirrus Tenjōin, then tell the Bell-Ringer Ayasha that Upper Yard belongs to the Shandians again.
quest.grandline.sky_7.desc: The bell can ring at last. Climb to the Bell-Ringer Ayasha, then read a poneglyph — Shandora's own stone waits in the ruins — while the White Sea and the Blue Sea below hear the bell.
quest.grandline.sky_8.desc: The guide at the Cloud End holds a message from Angel Island for a Sky People girl who fell to the Blue Sea as a child. Find Aria 'Skylark' Fuusen and deliver it.
quest.grandline.sphinx_1.desc: Young pirates who don't know the Cloudbridge's colours are raiding Sphinx. Defeat 8.
quest.grandline.spider_1.desc: Nell the junk-picker wants her scrap back from the Scrap Baron's thugs. Defeat 3 bandits and bring her 6 iron ingots.
quest.grandline.st_poplar_1.desc: Pirates stole every bloom in the greenhouse before the Spring Queen's crowning. Bring Rosalind 12 flowers of any kind.
quest.grandline.swallow_1.desc: Commander Bjorn's forge on Swallow Island is beset by bandits. Defeat 5.
Commander Bjorn needs the Marine inspectors gone before the next shipment leaves the forge. Defeat 3 Marines.
quest.grandline.torino_1.desc: Mother Kestrel needs 8 feathers for the festival crowns, and 3 bandits gone from the nesting trees.
